root.label: Elise Stefanik withdraws UN ambassador nomination

events.label: Elise Stefanik withdraws UN ambassador nomination

slots.name: withdrawal date
slots.sentence: Stefanik, a Trump ally, was nominated by the president to be the U.S. ambassador to the United Nations, but she complied with Trump's request to withdraw her nomination in 2025 after he said he did not want to risk losing a Republican seat in the House where the GOP holds a slim majority.
